title: Ecgberht Campaign Roadmap (append-only events + derived projection)
description: Roadmap is engine truth. roadmap_events[] is append-only history — prior entries are never rewritten. roadmap_projection is DERIVED from the event fold only (single writer: appendRoadmapEvent via roadmap-propose / roadmap-set; TW3 job lifecycle binds via commission_bind + status_flip through the same writer — no dual-write, no second store). A status flip without a receipt event is refused/rejected. Heal rebuilds the projection from events; events are never healed. Face prose alone is an honest gap (empty projection) — steps are never invented from narrative.

roadmap_events.description: Append-only event history; contiguous seq; prior entries must never be rewritten in place

at.description: ISO date the event was appended

due.description: optional calendar date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD (W0, High Seat 2026-09-26)

ref.description: a part that points at another record (W0b, High Seat 2026-09-26); a ref step carries no due and is never flipped here

tier.description: an initiative's priority tier on its heading step (W0b)

active.description: the active set (2026-09-29): an initiative he works on now; set only by his act

active_order.description: its place in the active set

pace.description: the date he drives the effort toward (an initiative; a part keeps due)

seat.description: where a goal's component he works interactively sits: active, on deck, or (absent) in its goal

area.description: an initiative's life area on its heading step (W0b)

gate.description: step_create: command that can fail; required to commission Crucible/Foreman

fields.description: step_set only; execution fields plus kickoff component/slice projection metadata (status → status_flip; commissioned_as → commission_bind)

component_ids.description: step_create kickoff projection: stable work-product component references

end_to_end_slice.description: step_create kickoff projection: this plan entry exercises the whole deliverable

receipt.description: REQUIRED on status_flip — a flip without receipt is refused (append) / rejected (rebuild)

commissioned_as.description: commission_bind only — TW3 job-lifecycle single-writer hook

refinement_projection.description: Derived from refinement_update events; never independently writable

roadmap_projection.description: DERIVED step list — rebuilt from roadmap_events on every append/heal; direct writes rejected. A stored projection that disagrees with the event fold is a silent rewrite → reject.

navigation.description: Optional validated shallow course/product groups, current pin and sparse exact-path artifact placements. Derived through step_set; no lifecycle authority.
